| Returns | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping |
| Product / specs / in the box | Same | Same |

The only material difference is under the seller name:

* **A:** Just says "Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio"
* **B:** Says **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

At the same price, that makes B the safer choice — you're more likely to get a genuine product and to have a full manufacturer warranty claim accepted.
